column1: # Hades II (Supergiant Games' engine on NVN, SDK 19.3.9 base / 20.5.15 update).
# Base game v0 (display version 0.0.126424) and update v1.0.137848 are both registered.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; values marked "Mario's" are not measured for this game yet.
# Unlike Hades (Vulkan), the Switch version renders with NVN: its 88 shaders are BNSH files in Shaders/NVN/bin (.vert / .frag; the .shader files list each program's pair).
# The ExeFS has only main and sdk. main's EOS_* imports (Epic Online Services, from nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro, loaded through nn::ro) stay offline: the host
# registers no NRR, so the game never loads the NRO.
# the right stick aims (the weapons with ManualAiming in Game/Weapons/PlayerWeapons.sjson)
# The update's build IDs come from its own ExeFS (the base game's from upstream's profile).
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. It asks for 3.10 GB (pool − used memory), which the 3.25 GB heap region of
# the 4 GB layout holds. main carries an 82 MB bss: the rewritten modules take more than the default 64 MB of used memory, so SetHeapSize(pool − 64 MB) would not fit
# ---- Widescreen (host only, NOT enabled for this game) ----
# The swapchain size 1280x720 is hardcoded twice in main: a rodata entry at +0x6d337c ({u32 w,
# u32 h}, dead data) and two immediate instructions at +0x2a6080 (movz/movk x8) that write it into
# a config object. Patching the rodata entry does nothing (the immediates win); patching the
# immediates too makes the init run and then crash later (main+0x48e5a4, null deref in the
# 0x2a7a20 call chain): the value feeds more than the swapchain, and whatever else depends on
# 1280x720 specifically is not satisfied by just widening it. Real widescreen for this title
# needs its resolution pipeline reversed — out of scope here.
# Round 2 detail: with the immediates patched to 1600x900, the init crashes at
# main+0x48e5a4 (ldr x2,[x21,#8] with a null x21) inside the 0x2a7a20 chain — the
# allocation at 0x499840 fails or a lookup misses for the wider size. d2r-mobile's
# widescreen works because its title's whole resolution path was brought up: PARAMS
# slots (4 sites) plus the KASPECT aspect cap plus the derived-mask fix, each found
# and tested one by one. The same depth of work is needed here.
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (Mario's values, the translator's built-in layout, except the texture slot count) ----
# The game's shaders bind textures at fixed, sparse slots: c2 handles at 0x20 + 8 r for r = 0, 1, 3, 6, 8, 11, 15, 21, 25, 26, 30, 31 and 34 over all 88 shaders.
# Slot 34 (SceneFade.frag, 0x130) lies past Mario's 32 slots, where his image table starts; this game has no image bindings and no shader reads c2 at run time
